name: Vera C. Rubin
quote: In a spiral galaxy, the ratio of dark-to-light matter is about a factor of ten. That's probably a good number for the ratio of our ignorance-to-knowledge. We're out of kindergarten, but only in about third grade.

name: Tony Tyson
role: Founding Director; originated the wide-field survey telescope concept in the early 1990s
quote: Named to the 2026 TIME100 for the observatory's first year of results, recognizing the survey-telescope concept he helped originate more than three decades earlier.

name: Željko Ivezić
quote: Rubin Observatory will deliver a 500-petabyte set of images and data products that will address some of the most pressing questions about the structure and evolution of the universe.

name: Aaron Roodman
role: Deputy Director (DOE) and LSST Camera Director, SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory
quote: The LSST Camera's images are so detailed it could resolve a golf ball from around 15 miles away, while covering a swath of the sky seven times wider than the full moon.

name: Sandrine Thomas
role: Deputy Director (NSF), Vera C. Rubin Observatory / AURA
quote: Leads the NSF side of Rubin Observatory operations alongside DOE counterparts, overseeing the transition from commissioning into full science survey operations.

name: Bob Blum
quote: Oversees Rubin Observatory operations under NOIRLab as the facility transitions from a construction project into a 10-year operating survey.

name: Charles Simonyi
role: Donor; Charles Simonyi Fund for Arts and Sciences
quote: His fund's $20 million gift in 2008 enabled fabrication of the telescope's unique three-mirror optical system, later named the Simonyi Survey Telescope in his honor.

name: Sethuraman Panchanathan
quote: It's a testament to the technical prowess and dedication of the entire NSF-DOE Rubin Observatory team — and the scientific community that has been striving to get to this point for over two decades.

name: Chris Wright
quote: DOE's Office of Science, through SLAC and Brookhaven, built the LSST Camera at the heart of Rubin's decade-long survey of the cosmos.

name: Gabriel Boric
quote: During a 2023 visit to Cerro Tololo, reaffirmed Chile's commitment to protecting its night skies as essential to safeguarding the astronomical science Rubin's operations represent.

name: Aisén Etcheverry
role: Chile Minister of Science, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation
quote: Reiterated her ministry's commitment to working with Rubin, Cerro Tololo, and Gemini South on avenues for technical collaboration with Chilean institutions.

name: France Córdova
role: Former NSF Director; present at the 2015 'First Stone' ceremony
quote: Joined Chilean President Michelle Bachelet at the April 2015 Cerro Pachón groundbreaking ceremony marking the formal start of summit construction.
